requirements_text: اختبر أن مربع الإدخال يقبل النص العربي وأن العداد يتحدث.
requirements_note: The requirements were written in Arabic; all other text in this report is in English.

scenarios.name: Add an Arabic todo item
scenarios.expected_result: The item appears in the list.

scenarios.name: Log in with the test user

failure_analysis.root_cause: The counter keeps showing 0 items after an item is added.
failure_analysis.evidence: assert_text failed: expected "1 item left", the page shows "0 items left". No console errors.
failure_analysis.explanation: The requirement states the counter must update, and the page does not do it, so this is not a test problem.

patches.reason: Changing the expected counter text would hide a possible application bug.
patches.requirement: The counter must update after an item is added.
patches.diff:
-  await expect(count).toContainText('1 item left');
+  await expect(count).toContainText('0 items left');

defect_candidates.summary: Counter does not update after adding an item.
